paper.title: Therapeutic treatments to cope with a love breakup: a systematic review

claims.text: Love breakups represent the second most common cause of traumatic events among university students between the ages of 17 and 26.
claims.evidence: Barajas-Márquez et al. (2017) found that love breakups were the second most common cause of traumatic events in a study with 326 university students between the ages of 17 and 26.

claims.text: Love breakups cause emotional distress, confusion, anguish, anxiety, stress, depression, suicidal attempts, sleeping disorders, and drug abuse.
claims.evidence: Romantic relationships...whose ending could represent an event causing emotional distress, confusion, anguish, anxiety, stress, depression, suicidal attempts, sleeping disorders, drug abuse

claims.text: Anxiety due to abandonment in Canadian adults experiencing a romantic breakup was related to depression symptoms and the severity and intensity of suicidal ideation.
claims.evidence: Brassard et al., (2018) found that anxiety due to abandonment in Canadian adults experiencing a breakup was related to depression symptoms and the severity and intensity of suicidal ideation.

claims.text: Love breakups represent the second cause of suicide among youngsters between 15 and 29 years of age in Chile.
claims.evidence: In Chile, love breakups represent the second cause of suicide among youngsters between 15 and 29 years of age (García et al., 2020).

claims.text: Among Ecuadorian adults experiencing a love breakup, 48.2% suffered from moderate to acute depression.
claims.evidence: Puente (2017) found that 48.2 % of a group of Ecuadorian adults experiencing a love breakup suffered from moderate to acute depression

claims.text: The systematic review found that most studies on therapeutic treatments for love breakups were conducted in the United States and Iran and were aimed at women.
claims.evidence: Most of the studies found were in the United States and Iran and aimed to women.

claims.text: Therapeutic treatments for love breakups showed a significant decrease in symptoms of depression and anxiety during the love breakup.
claims.evidence: The studies showed a significant decrease in symptoms of depression and anxiety during the love breakup.

claims.text: Mental health difficulties associated with couple difficulties are one of the main reasons for clinical attention.
claims.evidence: mental health difficulties associated with couple difficulties are one of the main reasons of clinical attention (Peel et al., 2018)

claims.text: Distress due to romantic relationship breakup is related to symptoms of depression, anxiety, sleep disorders, poor academic performance, and disorganized behavior in university students.
claims.evidence: Field et al. (2011)...found that distress due to breakup is related to symptoms of depression, anxiety, sleep disorders, poor academic performance, and disorganized behavior.
